# Top-k sweep (NaiveReason, BM25 and e5) (generated by experiments/_shared/summarize.py)

NaiveReason (one call per question), Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-AWQ on a Colab T4, greedy, slice `s900.json` (900 questions, 100 per hop, all 12 users). k = 20 is the committed session-1 run (tag `s1`); k = 10, 30, 50 are tag `s3_topk`. recall@k / all-gold@k are the retrieval-only numbers of the same questions (no LLM), mean over the questions of the subset. Intervals: 95% bootstrap over questions (2000 resamples); paired differences use a paired bootstrap on the same questions. Leak-free = questions sharing no number with their gold statements (any-number rule).
